faqs.question: How does WatchHub guarantee 100% genuine authenticity of all timepieces?
faqs.answer: Every timepiece listed on WatchHub undergoes a rigorous 48-point physical and horological verification by master watchmakers certified by the Federation of the Swiss Watch Industry (FH). We verify the movement serials, laser engraved hallmarks, balance wheel oscillations, and escapement tolerances. All pieces are delivered with original manufacturer paperwork, serialized warranty cards, and WatchHub's digital NFT authenticity certificate.

faqs.question: What delivery options and insurance are provided for multi-thousand dollar watches?
faqs.answer: We offer complimentary worldwide Armored Courier delivery (via Malca-Amit and Ferrari Group). All shipments are 100% fully insured for their full replacement value up until the physical handover. Direct photo identification and physical biometric/handwritten signature are required upon delivery.

faqs.question: What warranty coverage is included with my purchase?
faqs.answer: All new watches retain the complete manufacturer warranty (up to 5 years). In addition, WatchHub provides our proprietary 2-Year International Horology Protection Plan covering mechanical movement servicing, water-resistance gasket testing, and ultrasonic case cleaning at no extra charge.

faqs.question: What payment methods are supported for high-value orders?
faqs.answer: We accept all major premium credit cards (Visa Infinite, Mastercard World Elite, American Express Centurion), Swiss IBAN wire transfers, certified bank drafts, and cryptocurrency (BTC, ETH, USDC). For bespoke or off-catalog allocations, our VIP Concierge arranges private private-banking escrow.
